title: Language Models Steer on Injected Uncertainty Tokens, but Fail to Self-Monitor In Situ
abstract: arXiv:2611.31228v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prompting language models to verbalize stepwise numerical confidence during generation is an increasingly popular approach for triggering backtracking and error correction in agentic reasoning. This strategy presupposes two capabilities: (1) in-situ monitoring fidelity (does confidence drop when an error occurs?) and (2) downstream steering control (does an uncertainty token causally steer the model to repair its error?). We evaluated four open-weights models (Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B, and Phi-4, 14.7B) across 15,200 math benchmark attempts, isolating 2,017 reasoning errors within each model's capability frontier. Applying 27,568 counterfactual continuations across these failure points, we demonstrate a consistent decoupling between monitoring and control.   On monitoring, all four models fail to detect their own errors. Verbalized confidence does not distinguish mistake steps from sound reasoning, yielding near-chance within

translated_title: 语言模型能被注入的不确定性标记引导转向，却无法在原位自我监控
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.31228v1 公告类型：新论文。摘要：提示语言模型在生成过程中逐步以数值形式表达置信度，是在智能体推理中触发回溯与纠错的日益流行的策略。这一策略预设了两种能力：（1）原位监控的保真度——当错误发生时，置信度是否会下降？以及（2）下游转向控制——不确定性标记是否能在因果上引导模型修复其错误？我们在15,200次数学基准测试尝试中评估了四个开源权重模型（Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B 和 Phi-4，14.7B），并在每个模型的能力边界内分离出2,017个推理错误。通过在这些失败点上应用27,568个反事实续写，我们证明了监控与控制之间存在一致的解耦。在监控方面，全部四个模型都无法检测到自身的错误：口头表达的置信度无法区分错误步骤与正确推理，区分能力接近随机水平……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文通过对四个开源模型的15,200次数学推理尝试和27,568个反事实续写的系统实验，揭示了语言模型“自我监控”与“转向控制”能力之间的一致性解耦——模型的口头置信度无法在原位察觉自身推理错误，但外部注入的不确定性标记却能在因果上有效引导模型修复错误。
en_tdlr: Through 15,200 math benchmark attempts and 27,568 counterfactual continuations across four open-weights models, this paper reveals a consistent decoupling between monitoring and steering: language models fail to detect their own reasoning errors in situ via verbalized confidence, yet injected uncertainty tokens causally steer them toward error repair.
